_about: Art subjects ahead of content (15 October): the bosses, elites and summons Ryan marked in chat (docs/bosses_proposal.md), rendered for his picks before their kits land. Each moves into content/foes.json with its kit once he has marked it, and content wins on an id both hold. The forge reads the same fields it reads from content (id, name, faction, size, design.sprite, design.variants), and design.where and design.look stand in for the domain's when a subject belongs to none (the summons). Names are working names.
